author: A.Wilson, 1814
habitat: 트인 습지, 물풀이 무성한 호수, 초지, 해안
summary: 북극권 숲 가까이의 트인 습지와 물풀이 무성한 호수, 초지에 사는 몸집 큰 잠수성 오리로, 겨울은 해안에서 난다. 먹이 생물이 풍부하고 잠수할 만큼 물이 깊으며 습지 식물이 빽빽한 곳에서, 가장 높은 수위보다 조금 낮은 자리에 둥지를 짓고 암갈색 기가 도는 올리브색 알을 7~9개 낳는다. 무리 지어 날 때 V자를 그리고 최고 시속 116km까지 낼 만큼 빠르며, 평소에는 잘 울지 않지만 구애할 때 수컷이 소리를 낸다. 서스캐처원, 브리티시컬럼비아, 앨버타, 마니토바 남부, 오리건, 유타 북부, 콜로라도, 네브래스카, 미네소타 등지에서 번식하고 북아메리카 해안과 브리티시컬럼비아, 매사추세츠 남부 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: sloping forehead running smoothly into the bill
male: foreparts look black at a distance

sexes.male: 몸 가운데는 흰색이고 앞부분은 멀리서 검게 보이며, 머리는 붉은 고동색이다.
sexes.female: 머리와 가슴은 갈색, 눈가와 멱은 밝은 갈색, 등은 회갈색, 옆구리는 회색이다.

similar.how: 흰죽지와 비슷하지만 길고 검은 부리가 이마와 완만한 각을 이루어 옆모습이 독특하다.

art.subject: Canvasback (Aythya valisineria), adult male in winter plumage, as worn from November to March: head and upper neck rich reddish chestnut, darkening to blackish around the bill base and forecrown; lower neck and breast black; back, scapulars and flanks very pale, almost white, with extremely fine grey vermiculation so the body looks white at a distance; rear end, tail and undertail coverts black. Bill long and entirely black; iris bright red; legs and feet grey.
art.pose: swimming low on open water, about to dive
art.scene: open coastal water of a calm bay in winter; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male winter, side view swimming: reddish-chestnut head with blackish face near the bill, forehead sloping straight into a long all-black bill, red eye, black breast and black rear that make the foreparts look black from a distance, whitish central body

adult female, side view swimming: pale brown head and neck, paler buff around the eye and on the throat, darker brown breast, grey-brown back and grey flanks, the same long black bill and wedge-shaped head profile, dark eye
art.build: Large, heavy-bodied diving duck, 50–61cm, clearly bigger than a Common Pochard and close to a Mallard in length; long-bodied and sitting low on the water. Head long and wedge-shaped: the forehead slopes in one straight line into the bill with no angle between them, the crown highest towards the rear. Bill long, about as long as the head, deep at the base and tapering, with no pale band. Short grey legs set far back. Wings hidden under the flank feathers at rest; in flight the upperwing is plain pale grey with no white wing-bar. Tail short and dark, often held flat on the water.
avoid: Do not give the bill a pale grey band or a short, concave profile — that is Common Pochard (Aythya ferina), which also has a grey, not whitish, body.
Do not draw a steep forehead or a rounded head; forehead and bill form one long straight slope.
Do not add a crest or tuft on the head.
Do not show a white wing-bar in flight; the upperwing is plain pale grey.
